parameters.query:
UPDATE token_balances
SET used_tokens = used_tokens + {{ $json.tokensUsed }},
    updated_at = now()
WHERE client_id = '{{ $json.clientId }}';

INSERT INTO token_transactions (client_id, agent_id, type, tokens, description)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.clientId }}',
  '{{ $json.agentId }}',
  'consumption',
  -{{ $json.tokensUsed }},
  'Consumo agente {{ $json.agentId }}'
);

SELECT 
  a.agent_id,
  a.client_id,
  a.email,
  a.business_name,
  a.business_type,
  a.business_category,
  a.price_range,
  a.products,
  a.delivery,
  a.payment_methods,
  a.faqs,
  a.objection_handling,
  a.agent_personality,
  a.required_info,
  a.warranty,
  a.payment_gateway,
  a.payment_links,
  a.custom_instructions,
  COALESCE(tb.available_tokens, 0)::bigint AS available_tokens,
  COALESCE(tb.is_active, true) AS tokens_active
FROM agents a
LEFT JOIN token_balances tb ON tb.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE a.agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data").item.json.agentId }}';

SELECT 
  COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'role', role,
        'message', message,
        'created_at', created_at
      ) ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) as chat_history
FROM chat_history
WHERE agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data").item.json.agentId }}'
  AND user_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data").item.json.userId }}'
LIMIT 50;

INSERT INTO chat_history (agent_id, user_id, role, message)
VALUES
  (
    '{{ $("Build Prompt").first().json.agentId }}',
    '{{ $("Build Prompt").first().json.userId }}',
    'user',
    '{{ ($("Build Prompt").first().json.userMessage || "").toString().replaceAll("'","''") }}'
  ),
  (
    '{{ $("Build Prompt").first().json.agentId }}',
    '{{ $("Build Prompt").first().json.userId }}',
    'assistant',
    '{{ ($("AI Agent").first().json.output || "").toString().replaceAll("'","''") }}'
  );

  a.products,

  a.required_info,

  a.custom_instructions,
  COALESCE(tb.available_tokens, 0)::bigint AS available_tokens,

FROM agents a
LEFT JOIN token_balances tb ON tb.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE a.agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.agentId }}';

SELECT

    json_agg(
      json_build_object('role', role, 'message', message, 'created_at', created_at)
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) as chat_history
FROM chat_history
WHERE agent_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.agentId }}'
  AND user_id = '{{ $("Normalize Webhook Data1").item.json.userId }}'
LIMIT 5;
